I received this product yesterday, and I honestly didn't know what it was because it was two acrylic pieces, 4 screws, and two metal bars. Haha! It didn't take long to remember that it was my brush stand, though. I got a little concerned when there weren't any instructions on how to put it together, but once I actually looked at the pieces, I could easily tell what went where and how to get to right. The image in this listing makes a good reference, too, in case you need to double check anything.

Once I got it together, I put all my brushes in it, and they look great! The stand is very stable. It doesn't wobble or fall over from the weight of the brushes, and it's such an easy way to keep them around/organized without the worry of the bristles getting messed up because they're jumbled up in a bag.

I also think that anyone who has a ten piece oval brush set that gets this stand could use it as a great piece in a beauty room/studio. If anyone who films on YouTube needs something to show off, this will do it perfectly! They don't need to use the brushes to show how nice they look! Being in a stand like this really gives them that "professional" appeal, in my opinion.

I'm very happy with this purchase, and it has a spot in my office so I don't have to carry these to and from work all the time! ^_^

review_title: Dark circles are brighter, the eyes look more awake, and the skin is supple and in prime condition as a base for makeup.
review_text: This is Jacob's wife writing the review of the Valentia True Glow Eye Cream. My biggest problem spot when applying makeup is the dark circles under my eyes. So, naturally, I am interested in products that claim to solve this problem. The Valentia True Glow Eye cream comes with beautiful packaging, an easy to use nozzle for dispersion, and simple to follow instructions for application. I tried the eye cream both at night before bed to see the overnight results and also in the morning before makeup application. I liked using the cream right before makeup application the best. It works well as an eye cream, but I like the fresh and well rested effect I get when I put it on in the morning. The cream feels a bit tacky to the touch a few moments after application, but this effect quickly fades as the cream soaks into the delicate skin around the eyes. I have very sensitive skin, and there was not a trace of stinging or irritation. The product has a pleasant and subtle smell. I love that this product uses great ingredients. You can tell how high quality the product is when you smooth it onto your eyes. The eye cream gets a 5 star rating from me for all of these reasons, but mostly because it simply works. It isn't magic, and it doesn't claim to be concealer, but it drastically improves the condition of the under eye area. Dark circles are brighter, the eyes look more awake, and the skin is supple and in prime condition as a base for makeup application.

The Valentia True Glow Eye cream comes with beautiful packaging, an easy to use nozzle for dispersion, and simple to follow instructions for application. I tried the eye cream both at night before bed to see the overnight results and also in the morning before makeup application. I liked using the cream right before makeup application the best. It works well as an eye cream, but I like the fresh and well rested effect I get when I put it on in the morning. The cream feels a bit tacky to the touch a few moments after application, but this effect quickly fades as the cream soaks into the delicate skin around the eyes. I have very sensitive skin, and there was not a trace of stinging or irritation. The product has a pleasant and subtle smell. I love that this product uses great ingredients. You can tell how high quality the product is when you smooth it onto your eyes. The eye cream gets a 5 star rating from me for all of these reasons, but mostly because it simply works. It isn't magic, and it doesn't claim to be concealer, but it drastically improves the condition of the under eye area. Dark circles are brighter, the eyes look more awake, and the skin is supple and in prime condition as a base for makeup application.
